meal_swaps.swap_item: Add 1 glass of fresh Amla-Beetroot juice (Vitamin C + Non-heme Iron) alongside morning meal.
Substitute plain dal with Palak Dal or Moringa Leaf Curry cooked in a cast iron kadai.
Replace tea/biscuits with Gur-Chana (30g roasted chickpeas + organic jaggery) or Halim Seed soaked drink.
Include 2 boiled desi eggs or 1 tall glass of fortified cow/soy milk.
Ensure 1 full bowl (200g) of fresh probiotic dahi (curd) or 100g fresh paneer cubes.
Incorporate fish curry (e.g. Rohu/Mackerel) or paneer/fortified tofu into the dinner menu.
Take morning meal near a sunlit window or spend 20 minutes in midday sunlight (11 AM - 1 PM).
Add sun-exposed sauteed mushrooms or fortified cooking oil/ghee in meal preparation.
Drink 1 glass of FSSAI fortified milk with crushed nuts (fat helps absorption).
Swap wheat bread with Ragi Dosa / Ragi Roti and white sesame chutney.
Add Moringa pods (drumstick) sambar and 1 cup set curd.
Snack on 2 tablespoons of roasted til (sesame seeds) with jaggery (Til-Gud).
Sprinkle 2 tbsp roasted pumpkin and watermelon seeds over poha/upma/porridge.
Opt for soaked and sprouted legume curries (sprouted moong or chana dal).
Use whole pearl millet (Bajra) rotis or khichdi instead of refined grains.
Include 1 bowl of raw sprouted moong salad with lemon juice and tomatoes.
Add steamed methi / palak or lady finger (bhindi) sabzi.
Consume 1 cup of fresh papaya, sweet lime (mosambi), or orange slices.
Add grated red carrots or papaya slices to morning plate.
Add yellow pumpkin curry or drumstick leaves sauteed in 1 tsp pure desi ghee.
Include spinach-methi sabzi prepared with healthy cooking fat for beta-carotene uptake.
